sloka: आकुलां नगरीं कृत्वा व्यथयित्वा च रावणम् ।अर्दयित्वा बलं घोरं वैदेहीमभिवाद्य च ।। 5.57.12 ।।।।
transliteration: ākulāṁ nagarīṁ kṛtvā vyathayitvā ca rāvaṇam ।ardayitvā balaṁ ghoraṁ vaidehīmabhivādya ca ।। 5.57.12 ।।।।

translations.english: The glorious Hanuman, having killed eminent ogres and thereby making himself widely known, having caused havoc to the city of Lanka and terrific sorrow to Ravana by tormenting the army, offered salutations to Vaidehi from midocean and continued his journey.
